title: BiomeWalker
description: Track your steps and distance per biome. HUD overlay with biome stats. Per-world data storage.
body:
**BiomeWalker**

BiomeWalker tracks every step you take and records your biome exploration progress. See exactly which biomes you've visited, how many steps you've taken in each one, and where most of your adventures happen.

Features HUD Overlay

Displays your current biome and total step count in the bottom-left corner of your screen.
![HUD](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/333f7a932ed59ae6dc5894f9d1f9a889e581655d_0.webp)

**Biome Statistics**

Press H to open a detailed statistics screen containing:

Every biome you've visited Steps taken per biome Percentage of total travel Progress bars for easy comparison Auto-Sprint

Press O to toggle auto-sprint and keep running without holding the sprint key.

**Per-World Data**

Statistics are saved separately for every singleplayer world and multiplayer server.

**Settings Menu**

Customize the HUD or reset your saved statistics through the settings menu.

Controls Key Action H Open biome statistics O Toggle auto-sprint

Requirements Minecraft 1.20.1 Fabric Loader Fabric API

**Why BiomeWalker?**

Whether you're exploring new terrain, completing biome challenges, or simply curious about your travel habits, BiomeWalker helps you track your journey across the Minecraft world.

Explore. Walk. Discover. Track your adventure. 🌍🚶
